name: Sumana Bhattacharjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sumana Bhattacharjee is a Kolkata poet whose work has appeared in GloMag, Setu and Our Poetry Archive. Her collection Eternal Thought: Music of Soul is published by Notion Press. Her contributor biographies also describe an interest in music and participation in online poetry communities.

“Once I belonged to a zamindar family” stages a conversation between inherited prestige and present necessity. Its speaker questions a grandfather’s insistence on rank, choosing ordinary life over a fading aristocratic ideal. Dusty glass, a dim ancestral space and feet constrained by silken thread make that choice tangible.
